highlights.title: QuickGPT (chat.uft1.com)
highlights.description: Multi-model chat studio that keeps friends online when chatgpt.com free tiers dry out. Sidebar persistence, regenerate/copy helpers, and Netlify functions proxy GPT-4o, GPT-3.5, and Claude models with transparent quota handling. The UI powers multiple users across chat.uft1.com, leveraging AI tooling for reliability.
